## Overview

In the statistical diversity lab (StatDivLab), we ... Here is a list of our software packages... 

| Method       | Topic                         | Short description     |
|--------------|----------------------------------|-------------|
| [breakaway](https://github.com/adw96/breakaway)    | Richness estimation              | ...   |
| [DivNet](https://github.com/adw96/DivNet)       | Alpha/beta diversity estimation  | ...     |
| [radEmu](https://github.com/statdivlab/radEmu)       | Differential abundance           | ...     |
| [fastEmu](https://github.com/statdivlab/fastEmu)       | Differential abundance           | ...     |
| [corncob](https://github.com/statdivlab/corncob)       | Differential abundance           | ...     |
| [paramedic](https://github.com/statdivlab/paramedic)       | Differential abundance with some absolute data          | ...     |
| [tinyvamp](https://github.com/statdivlab/tinyvamp)       | Differential abundance with dilution series        | ...     |
| [happi](https://github.com/statdivlab/happi)       | Gene presence        | ...     |
| [enviromtx](https://github.com/statdivlab/enviromtx)       | Gene expression (??)    | ...     |
| [groves](https://github.com/statdivlab/groves)       | Phylogenetics          | ...     |
| [ExtnSpaces](https://github.com/statdivlab/ExtnSpaces)       | Phylogenetics         | ...     |
| [rigr](https://github.com/statdivlab/rigr)       | General statistical tools          | ...     |
| [raoBust](https://github.com/statdivlab/raoBust)       | Robust testing           | ...     |
| [KikWalk](https://github.com/statdivlab/KikWalk)       | Data analysis           | mammoths!!!    |

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph flowchart {
  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]

  node [style=filled, fillcolor=white, fontsize = 18, width = 2, height = 1.2, fixedsize=false]
  edge [fontsize = 16]

  // Define shapes
  node [shape = none]
  Q1 [label = 'I care about...']
  Q2 [label = 'I want to estimate?']

  node [shape = ellipse]
  A1 [label = 'diversity estimation']
  A2 [label = 'differential abundance analysis']
  A3 [label = 'phylogenetics']
  A4 [label = 'other microbiome questions']
  A5 [label = 'other statistical tools']
  A6 [label = 'Richness']
  A7 [label = <&alpha;/&beta; Diversity>]
  
  node [shape = box]
  S1 [label = 'breakaway', URL=\"https://github.com/adw96/breakaway\"]
  S2 [label = 'DivNet', URL=\"https://github.com/adw96/DivNet\"]

  // Connect nodes
  Q1 -> A1
  Q1 -> A2
  Q1 -> A3
  Q1 -> A4
  Q1 -> A5
  A1 -> Q2
  Q2 -> A6
  Q2 -> A7
  A6 -> S1
  A7 -> S2
}
")

```
